title: From Police Officer to Trainee Clinical Psychologist at Age 47

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Medically retired at 40, trainee clinical psychologist at 47.
sentences.zh: 40 岁因病退休，47 岁成为临床心理学实习生。

sentences.en: Claire's story is one of reinvention, resilience and doing the impossible.
sentences.zh: Claire 的故事是一个关于重塑自我、韧性以及创造不可能的故事。

sentences.en: Landing a place on the doctorate in clinical psychology on her first ever application.
sentences.zh: 她第一次申请就成功获得了临床心理学博士课程的名额。

sentences.en: If you've ever questioned whether it's too late for you to chase your dreams or feared that you don't fit the mould,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经怀疑现在追逐梦想是否太晚，或者担心自己不符合标准，

sentences.en: this episode will show you exactly why that thinking needs to change.
sentences.zh: 这一集将告诉你为什么这种想法需要改变。

sentences.en: Hope you find it super useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Some of my most popular content on YouTube has been that of older applicants.
sentences.zh: 我在 YouTube 上最受欢迎的内容之一就是关于大龄申请者的。

sentences.en: Whilst we mention YouTube, if you don't already like and subscribe, please do take a moment to do that now.
sentences.zh: 既然提到了 YouTube，如果你还没有点赞和订阅，请现在花点时间去做。

sentences.en: Today's episode is helping us take a look at an older applicant.
sentences.zh: 今天这一集将帮助我们了解一位大龄申请者。

sentences.en: She is 47 currently and has just gained a place as a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 她今年 47 岁，刚刚获得了临床心理学实习生的名额。

sentences.en: It is a fascinating episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一集非常引人入胜的节目。

sentences.en: We do discuss issues around suicide, around traumatic workplace settings, around prison.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了关于自杀、创伤性工作环境以及监狱等问题。

sentences.en: So if you are around young ears or you think that maybe now is not the most appropriate time for you to look after yourself,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果周围有孩子，或者你觉得现在可能不是照顾自己的最合适时机，

sentences.en: please do feel free to come back to this episode at a later stage.
sentences.zh: 请随时在以后的时间再回来收听这一集。

sentences.en: Hope you find it really useful and I'll catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它真的很有用，我们稍后再见。

sentences.en: So Claire Dunn, welcome along to the podcast and congratulations on becoming an incoming trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 那么，Claire Dunn，欢迎来到播客，祝贺你成为即将入职的临床心理学实习生。

sentences.en: Thanks for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's such a privilege to be invited to come along and join you today.
sentences.zh: 是的，今天能受邀参加你的节目真是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Well, we got chatting on LinkedIn, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我们是在 LinkedIn 上聊起来的，对吧？

sentences.en: And your story is not typical and I love it because actually you had a successful career in the police.
sentences.zh: 你的故事很不寻常，我非常喜欢，因为你实际上在警察局有过成功的职业生涯。

sentences.en: You rose to the level of police sergeant and I hope it's okay to say that your current age is, let me say, you say your current age.
sentences.zh: 你晋升到了警佐级别，我希望可以说出你现在的年龄，让我说，你自己说出你现在的年龄吧。

sentences.en: How old are you, Claire?
sentences.zh: 你多大了，Claire？

sentences.en: Claire Dunn, I'm very proudly 47.
sentences.zh: Claire Dunn，我非常自豪地说我 47 岁了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you've had a career in the police and then obviously at some point you thought,
sentences.zh: 所以你曾在警察局工作，然后在某个时候你想到，

sentences.en: no, I think maybe psychology is actually where I want to be.
sentences.zh: 不，我想也许心理学才是我真正想去的地方。

sentences.en: Could you talk us through some of that, Claire?
sentences.zh: Claire，你能给我们讲讲其中的一些经历吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I joined the police at 20.
sentences.zh: 好的，我 20 岁时加入了警察局。

sentences.en: I really didn't really know what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道自己想做什么。

sentences.en: I wasn't a child that grew up wanting to be a police officer.
sentences.zh: 我小时候并没有立志要当警察。

sentences.en: If I'm honest, I wanted to be a Blue Peter presenter.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我想成为一名《Blue Peter》的主持人。

sentences.en: And at the age of 20, I kind of thought that's unrealistically going to happen.
sentences.zh: 在 20 岁时，我觉得那是不切实际的。

sentences.en: And I had a friend join the police and I really was excited about the things she was doing and the riot training.
sentences.zh: 我有一个朋友加入了警察局，我对她所做的事情和防暴训练感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, I'll give that a whirl.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，我也去试试看。

sentences.en: I applied and I got in straight away, which I was really quite surprised about, if I'm honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我申请了，而且立刻就被录取了，说实话，我对此感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: So at 20, I started my police career.
sentences.zh: 所以 20 岁时，我开始了我的警察生涯。

sentences.en: At the age of 27, I was promoted to police sergeant and I worked predominantly response.
sentences.zh: 27 岁时，我被提升为警佐，主要负责响应工作。

sentences.en: So your blue lights, your urgent jobs.
sentences.zh: 也就是你的警灯，你的紧急任务。

sentences.en: I specialised also in child video interviews.
sentences.zh: 我还专门从事儿童视频采访工作。

sentences.en: So children who were witnesses or victims of crime, custody.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些作为犯罪证人或受害者的儿童，以及拘留所工作。

sentences.en: I did a stint as custody sergeant, which I enjoyed very much.
sentences.zh: 我做过一段时间的拘留警佐，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And I completed 18 years service.
sentences.zh: 我完成了 18 年的服务。

sentences.en: However, towards the end of my service,
sentences.zh: 然而，在服务接近尾声时，

sentences.en: it became apparent that my mental health had been quite severely impacted by some of the trauma that I'd been exposed to through the incidents I'd attended.
sentences.zh: 很明显，我的心理健康受到了严重影响，这是因为我在处理案件时接触到的一些创伤。

sentences.en: And there were maybe four or five incidents that I kind of had, you know, reoccurring thoughts about and struggled to process.
sentences.zh: 大约有四五起事件，我一直有反复出现的想法，并且难以处理。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, a decision was made that I needed to be medically retired.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，最终决定我需要因病退休。

sentences.en: I was diagnosed with PTSD as a result of attending those incidents.
sentences.zh: 我被诊断出患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），这是处理这些事件的结果。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, my career came to quite an abrupt end at the age of 38.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我的职业生涯在 38 岁时戛然而止。

sentences.en: And I found myself having finished one career, wondering what I was going to do next.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己结束了一份职业，却不知道接下来要做什么。

sentences.en: I was very clear I didn't want my life to be defined by a job I once did.
sentences.zh: 我非常清楚，我不希望我的生活被我曾经做过的工作所定义。

sentences.en: And it was really important to me that I had a second identity.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，拥有第二个身份非常重要。

sentences.en: Very few police officers go on to do anything else.
sentences.zh: 很少有警察会去做其他事情。

sentences.en: Once a police officer, always a police officer.
sentences.zh: 一旦成为警察，就永远是警察。

sentences.en: And that was very much the narrative and the culture from which I came from.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上是我所处的叙事和文化。

sentences.en: And at 38, I had a medical pension.
sentences.zh: 38 岁时，我有了医疗养老金。

sentences.en: I could have, you know, kept it there.
sentences.zh: 我本可以，你知道，就那样维持着。

sentences.en: But I decided, no, I wanted, it was really important to me to have a second really meaningful career in which to live out the rest of my life with.
sentences.zh: 但我决定不，我想要，对我来说，拥有第二个非常有意义的职业来度过余生非常重要。

sentences.en: I'm not someone that wants to retire at 65 or I'm very much working is part of who I am and my identity.
sentences.zh: 我不是那种想在 65 岁退休的人，工作很大程度上是我身份的一部分。

sentences.en: But it needed to be something equally as meaningful.
sentences.zh: 但它需要同样有意义。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, thank you, you know, on behalf of the great British public for the service that you provided in policing.
sentences.zh: 是的，代表伟大的英国公众，感谢你为警务工作所做的贡献。

sentences.en: It's not an easy job and it is, you know, very nuanced.
sentences.zh: 这不是一份容易的工作，而且，你知道，非常微妙。

sentences.en: It's very important.
sentences.zh: 它非常重要。

sentences.en: But it also does have an impact.
sentences.zh: 但它确实会产生影响。

sentences.en: And actually, medical retirement is not uncommon, I've experienced, in police services.
sentences.zh: 事实上，据我所知，在警察部门中，因病退休并不罕见。

sentences.en: But also, nor does it come without, you know, great levels of sometimes shame and regret and blame and kind of sadness about that.
sentences.zh: 但这往往也伴随着巨大的羞耻感、遗憾、自责以及某种悲伤。

sentences.en: Because people have often really enjoyed working in the police and that part of their identity.
sentences.zh: 因为人们通常真的很喜欢在警察局工作，喜欢那部分身份。

sentences.en: And so when medical retirement is kind of first mooted, that sometimes feels quite challenging in itself.
sentences.zh: 所以当因病退休被提出来时，这本身有时感觉就非常有挑战性。

sentences.en: And we probably could do another whole episode on that and maybe we will in future.
sentences.zh: 我们可能可以就此再做一整集节目，也许将来会这样做。

sentences.en: But how did you then begin to think about psychology?
sentences.zh: 但你是如何开始考虑心理学的呢？

sentences.en: So I studied psychology at A-level.
sentences.zh: 我在 A-level 阶段学习过心理学。

sentences.en: I'd always really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢它。

sentences.en: I was always fascinated by human behaviour.
sentences.zh: 我一直对人类行为很着迷。

sentences.en: And as a police officer, I, unlike many of my colleagues, I did look beyond the offender.
sentences.zh: 作为一名警察，我与许多同事不同，我不仅关注罪犯本身。

sentences.en: And I always wanted to understand, I had this real innate desire to understand how offenders came to be where they were at that point in time.
sentences.zh: 我总是想了解，我有一种天生的渴望，想了解罪犯是如何在那个时间点走到那一步的。

sentences.en: What was their back story?
sentences.zh: 他们的背景故事是什么？

sentences.en: I don't believe people are born mad or bad.
sentences.zh: 我不相信人天生就是疯狂或邪恶的。

sentences.en: There is always a back story and working in custody.
sentences.zh: 总有一个背景故事，我在拘留所工作时就发现了。

sentences.en: And as a police constable, I would spend a lot of time conducting constant supervisions with detainees within custody to safeguard them because they were a risk to themselves.
sentences.zh: 作为一名警员，我会花很多时间对拘留所里的被拘留者进行持续监督，以保护他们，因为他们对自己有风险。

sentences.en: There was either a suicidal or a self-harm risk.
sentences.zh: 要么有自杀风险，要么有自残风险。

sentences.en: So I could spend upwards of 10 hours a day, literally sat outside a cell and talking with offenders, young and old.
sentences.zh: 所以我每天可以花超过 10 个小时，真的坐在牢房外，与罪犯交谈，无论老少。

sentences.en: And it became really apparent that there was a trauma theme that ran through pretty much every offender I met.
sentences.zh: 很明显，我遇到的几乎每个罪犯身上都有一个创伤主题。

sentences.en: And that trauma then translated into substance misuse, so be it drugs, alcohol.
sentences.zh: 而这种创伤随后转化为药物滥用，无论是毒品还是酒精。

sentences.en: They became incredibly vulnerable, in particular, the females that I encountered and in turn turned to offending behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他们变得非常脆弱，特别是那些我遇到的女性，进而转向犯罪行为。

sentences.en: And it was this cycle that was perpetuated by the trauma that they had experienced.
sentences.zh: 正是这种由他们经历的创伤所延续的循环。

sentences.en: But as a police officer, it's a very punitive role.
sentences.zh: 但作为一名警察，这是一个非常惩罚性的角色。

sentences.en: And there is no opportunity, really, to kind of support in any type of rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 而且真的没有机会去支持任何形式的康复。

sentences.en: So when I came out of the police and I was medically retired, I thought again about psychology and mental health specifically.
sentences.zh: 所以当我离开警察局并因病退休时，我再次想到了心理学，特别是心理健康。

sentences.en: I attended more attempted and completed suicides than I can recall.
sentences.zh: 我参加过我记不清次数的自杀未遂和自杀身亡现场。

sentences.en: The number was so devastating, actually.
sentences.zh: 那个数字实际上非常令人震惊。

sentences.en: And I can talk a little bit about some of those experiences later.
sentences.zh: 我以后可以再谈谈其中一些经历。

sentences.en: But I felt quite drawn to mental health and improving the lives of others that were struggling with mental health.
sentences.zh: 但我感到被心理健康所吸引，并希望改善那些在心理健康方面挣扎的人的生活。

sentences.en: And we know that offending behaviour and mental health go hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 我们知道犯罪行为和心理健康是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: Trauma and mental health and offending behaviour also go hand in hand as well.
sentences.zh: 创伤、心理健康和犯罪行为也是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: So on a whim, and literally on a whim, late 1 August, I decided to sign up for the Open University Psychology degree that started the following month.
sentences.zh: 所以一时兴起，真的是一时兴起，在 8 月下旬，我决定报名参加下个月开始的开放大学心理学学位课程。

sentences.en: And it really was on a whim.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一时兴起。

sentences.en: I had done a degree.
sentences.zh: 我之前已经拿过一个学位了。

sentences.en: I made the decision to go straight into the police rather than do a degree.
sentences.zh: 我当时决定直接进入警察局，而不是去读学位。

sentences.en: I was meant to do primary school teaching and I changed my mind at the last minute and didn't go.
sentences.zh: 我本打算去教小学，但在最后一刻改变了主意，没有去。

sentences.en: So on a whim, I signed up for the degree.
sentences.zh: 所以一时兴起，我报名参加了这个学位课程。

sentences.en: And that's where it all started.
sentences.zh: 这就是一切的开始。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And we'll perhaps hear a bit more about your experiences and kind of flexible learning and self-paced learning often a little bit later.
sentences.zh: 也许我们稍后会更多地听到你关于灵活学习和自定进度学习的经历。

sentences.en: But I just wanted to pick up on what you'd said about, you know, the prison service and the justice services being full of traumatised people.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想接着你刚才说的，关于监狱服务和司法服务充满了受过创伤的人。

sentences.en: And it's so incredibly true.
sentences.zh: 这是千真万确的。

sentences.en: And if people want to learn more about that, I would really recommend an incredible book by Chris Daw QC, which is called Justice on Trial.
sentences.zh: 如果人们想了解更多，我强烈推荐 Chris Daw QC 写的一本令人难以置信的书，书名叫《审判中的正义》（Justice on Trial）。

sentences.en: Such an interesting book.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣的一本书。

sentences.en: And I might well reach out to Chris and see if he'll come and talk to us on the podcast because it's such, such an interesting topic.
sentences.zh: 我可能会联系 Chris，看看他是否愿意来我们的播客做客，因为这是一个非常、非常有趣的话题。

sentences.en: And I'm intrigued about, you know, before you started your undergrad with the OU, did you have any relevant experience roles working in kind of mental health?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，在你开始开放大学的本科学习之前，你是否有过任何相关的心理健康工作经验？

sentences.en: So shortly, shortly after I was medically retired and once I was well again, having received quite intense CBT therapy,
sentences.zh: 在我因病退休后不久，一旦我康复了，在接受了相当强度的 CBT 治疗后，

sentences.en: I made the decision to start working with young people in alternative education.
sentences.zh: 我决定开始与替代教育中的年轻人一起工作。

sentences.en: So I worked for an alternative education provision, which are very similar to what were known as PRU, so pupil referral units.
sentences.zh: 我为一家替代教育机构工作，这与所谓的 PRU（学生转介单位）非常相似。

sentences.en: So they're settings that provide alternative education for young people that are unable to access full time mainstream education due to a number of enduring issues,
sentences.zh: 它们是为那些由于多种长期问题而无法接受全日制主流教育的年轻人提供替代教育的场所，

sentences.en: including mental health issues and challenging behaviour arising from trauma.
sentences.zh: 包括心理健康问题和因创伤引起的挑战性行为。

sentences.en: I worked predominantly with looked after children.
sentences.zh: 我主要与受照顾的儿童一起工作。

sentences.en: I did that for five and a half years in total.
sentences.zh: 我总共做了五年半。

sentences.en: And I worked in that setting on a part time basis alongside my degree with the Open University.
sentences.zh: 我在开放大学攻读学位的同时，以兼职的方式在那个环境中工作。

sentences.en: So I feel that it gave me a lot of experience and I was able to really reflect on what I was learning within the content of the psychology degree and kind of reflect and put that into practice with working with these young people.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉它给了我很多经验，我能够真正反思我在心理学学位内容中学到的东西，并将其付诸实践，与这些年轻人一起工作。

sentences.en: So really, really super helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以真的，真的非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And how long did it take you to do your undergrad degree?
sentences.zh: 你花多长时间完成本科课程的？

sentences.en: And a question I've always wondered, do you still get like an in-person graduation, even though it's kind of all remote?
sentences.zh: 我一直有一个疑问，即使是远程学习，你仍然会有像线下的毕业典礼吗？

sentences.en: You do.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: You do.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: And actually, that graduation was something I held in mind.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那个毕业典礼是我一直记在心里的事情。

sentences.en: And my best friend had completed her teaching degree with the Open University before.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友之前在开放大学完成了她的教学学位。

sentences.en: And I remember her on her graduation walking across the stage at the Barbican Theatre in London.
sentences.zh: 我记得她在伦敦巴比肯剧院的毕业典礼上走上舞台的样子。

sentences.en: And on those really difficult days, nights, early hours of the morning when I'm trying to meet deadlines of assignments, it was that that I really held in mind.
sentences.zh: 在那些非常困难的日子、夜晚、凌晨，当我试图赶作业截止日期时，正是那个场景一直在我脑海中。

sentences.en: So the degree in total on a part time basis is six years.
sentences.zh: 所以这个学位总共兼职需要六年。

sentences.en: However, in year one, there is the opportunity where you can kind of do two modules immediately after each other.
sentences.zh: 然而，在第一年，有机会可以连续修两门课程。

sentences.en: So whereas you would normally work from October, the course would start and you would normally finish at the start of June.
sentences.zh: 所以通常你会从 10 月开始工作，课程会在 6 月初结束。

sentences.en: I have the opportunity to complete the second module, which is the equivalent of the second year by starting that.
sentences.zh: 我有机会完成第二门课程，也就是相当于第二年的课程，通过开始学习它。

sentences.en: I think I started that in around March and that went all the way through to the end of September.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在 3 月左右开始的，一直持续到 9 月底。

sentences.en: So in that first year, I had about four months where I overlapped two modules.
sentences.zh: 所以在第一年，我有大约四个月的时间重叠了两门课程。

sentences.en: And that was really, really challenging in terms of time.
sentences.zh: 在时间方面，这真的、真的很有挑战性。

sentences.en: When I started my degree, my children were 11 and 13.
sentences.zh: 当我开始攻读学位时，我的孩子们分别是 11 岁和 13 岁。

sentences.en: So I was still very much a mum and the commitments of all the clubs and, you know, school and everything like that.
sentences.zh: 所以我仍然是一个母亲，还要承担所有的俱乐部、学校以及所有类似的事情。

sentences.en: My daughter was still in primary school.
sentences.zh: 当时我女儿还在上小学。

sentences.en: So I was still doing school pickup and balancing working in the in the school as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我还得负责接送孩子，同时还要兼顾在学校的工作。

sentences.en: So that first year was really tough.
sentences.zh: 所以第一年真的非常艰难。

sentences.en: However, it paid dividend because it actually reduced the length of the course from six years to five years.
sentences.zh: 不过，这很有成效，因为它实际上把课程时长从六年缩短到了五年。

sentences.en: It did mean I didn't get a summer break from it in that first year.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我在第一年确实没有暑假可言。

sentences.en: But it did mean that I was able to complete the degree in five years, which I actually really recommend for anybody.
sentences.zh: 但这也意味着我能够用五年时间完成学位，我真心向所有人推荐这样做。

sentences.en: If you can manage to do that, then I think that's really, really helpful to reduce it by a year.
sentences.zh: 如果你能做到这一点，我认为能缩短一年时间真的非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: So and what what stage are we at now?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们现在处于什么阶段呢？

sentences.en: How long was it ago that you graduated from your OU degree?
sentences.zh: 你从开放大学（OU）毕业多久了？

sentences.en: So I started in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我是2018年开始的。

sentences.en: I completed in June 2023, graduating in September 2023.
sentences.zh: 我在2023年6月完成学业，2023年9月毕业。

sentences.en: So it's been we're coming up for, yeah, two over two years now.
sentences.zh: 所以算下来，差不多有两年多了。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And what have you been doing since?
sentences.zh: 那之后你一直在做什么？

sentences.en: So as soon as I had, I received my result, my classification, I worked really hard.
sentences.zh: 我一拿到成绩和学位等级，就非常努力地工作。

sentences.en: I was very driven to achieving a firSt.
sentences.zh: 我当时一心想拿到一等学位。

sentences.en: And the reason I was so driven to achieving a first is I had watched a, joined a webinar about clinical psychology and roots into clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这么执着于拿一等学位，是因为我当时参加了一个关于临床心理学以及如何进入该领域的网络研讨会。

sentences.en: And at this point, I knew nothing like I didn't even really know the difference between a clinical psychologist, a counselling psychologist, forensic, educational.
sentences.zh: 那时我对这一行一无所知，甚至分不清临床心理学家、咨询心理学家、法医心理学家和教育心理学家之间的区别。

sentences.en: And I watched this webinar and I saw the success rate in terms of age.
sentences.zh: 我看了那个研讨会，看到了按年龄划分的成功率。

sentences.en: And then it got to the 40s and it was I think it was less than one percent.
sentences.zh: 当看到40多岁这一档时，成功率好像不到百分之一。

sentences.en: And it was really emphasised that how competitive it was and a first class degree was really quite important.
sentences.zh: 研讨会反复强调了竞争有多激烈，而一等学位确实非常重要。

sentences.en: So I made it my, really my life's work really at the time to secure that firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时把它当作了人生头等大事，一定要拿到那个一等学位。

sentences.en: So as soon as I had that confirmation that I'd received the first and I had my degree was all confirmed, I started applying for assistant psychologist roles within the local area.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦确认拿到一等学位且学位获得认证后，我就开始在当地申请助理心理学家职位。

sentences.en: I had one interview quite quickly, I didn't get the job,
sentences.zh: 我很快就获得了一次面试机会，但没被录用。

sentences.en: I got some really lovely feedback and the feedback I got was the applicant that we have recruited had previous NHS experience a week and that was evidence through the language that they used that they'd worked within the NHS before.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一些非常中肯的反馈，反馈说录用的那个人有英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的工作经验，而且从他们使用的专业术语中就能看出他们之前在NHS工作过。

sentences.en: I then went again, I got another interview very quickly and within a month I had secured an assistant psychology post and this was in a mental health support team,
sentences.zh: 后来我又申请了，很快又得到了一次面试机会，一个月内我就获得了一个助理心理学家的职位，是在一个心理健康支持团队里，

sentences.en: so working in schools.
sentences.zh: 也就是在学校里工作。

sentences.en: So actually, even though I didn't have that clinical NHS experience, the experience I'd gained through working within an education setting really placed me in a really good,
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，尽管我没有NHS的临床经验，但我通过在教育环境中所积累的经验，确实让我处于一个非常好的、

sentences.en: strong position for that poSt.
sentences.zh: 非常有竞争力的位置，从而获得了那个职位。

sentences.en: And I was really fortunate that I got that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很幸运能得到它。

sentences.en: Well done to you.
sentences.zh: 做得好。

sentences.en: And I know that when I chatted with Sam previously about kind of the barriers to progressing in psychology when you might be slightly older than the average applicant,
sentences.zh: 我知道之前我和Sam聊过关于心理学职业发展障碍的问题，特别是当你比一般申请者年龄稍大时，

sentences.en: that actually the salary of an AP role, typically at band four or band five, can keep people quite stuck from accessing that route.
sentences.zh: 助理心理学家（AP）职位的薪水通常在四级或五级，这可能会让人们很难进入这个行业。

sentences.en: Because, of course, if you've got a family to support, that is not a massive salary in this day and age.
sentences.zh: 因为当然了，如果你要养家糊口，在当今这个时代，那点薪水并不算多。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing the police pension obviously helps subsidise that to make it more accessible for you.
sentences.zh: 我猜警察养老金显然有助于补贴这一点，让你更容易负担得起。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm very pleased to hear that you've been able to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，听到你能做到这一点我非常高兴。

sentences.en: And I guess ultimately that's meant that you are now, you know, you've been able to apply to the doctorate in clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 我想最终这意味着你现在已经能够申请临床心理学博士学位了。

sentences.en: I think I'm right in saying the first time and then you were successful and have got on.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，你是第一次申请就成功被录取了。

sentences.en: So tell us about that process for you.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我们讲讲你的这个过程吧。

sentences.en: So the process of becoming an AP in terms of salary that you've mentioned is really problematic.
sentences.zh: 关于你提到的薪水问题，成为助理心理学家的过程确实存在很大问题。

sentences.en: And it's something I feel quite passionate about, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实也是我非常关心的事情。

sentences.en: I'm very fortunate.
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运。

sentences.en: I have a husband who brings in a good income.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫有不错的收入。

sentences.en: And alongside my police pension, I could supplement my salary with my pension.
sentences.zh: 再加上我的警察养老金，我可以用养老金来补贴我的薪水。

sentences.en: I could top it up.
sentences.zh: 我可以把它补足。

sentences.en: Had I been an older applicant with children, it would have been impossible.
sentences.zh: 如果我是一个有孩子的年长申请者，那是不可能做到的。

sentences.en: You cannot survive on it.
sentences.zh: 你根本无法靠那点钱生存。

sentences.en: I think I worked it out.
sentences.zh: 我想我算过。

sentences.en: It's something like £12 an hour.
sentences.zh: 大概每小时12英镑左右。

sentences.en: I could have got paid more in Aldi, working in Aldi or Lidl.
sentences.zh: 我在阿尔迪（Aldi）或利多（Lidl）超市工作赚的钱可能都比这多。

sentences.en: At the time, I think they were paying £13 an hour.
sentences.zh: 当时我记得他们每小时支付13英镑。

sentences.en: So it's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很难。

sentences.en: It's extremely problematic.
sentences.zh: 这极其成问题。

sentences.en: And again, it closes that route off to so many people that are not in that privileged position to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且再次强调，它把许多没有这种优越条件的人拒之门外。

sentences.en: And something needs to change.
sentences.zh: 有些事情必须改变。

sentences.en: And that's something, when I am qualified and I feel that my voice can be heard a little more, that I would like to advocate.
sentences.zh: 等我获得资格，觉得自己的声音能被更多人听到时，我希望能为此进行倡导。

sentences.en: In particular, older entrants, APs.
sentences.zh: 特别是针对那些大龄入行的助理心理学家。

sentences.en: The majority of APs I work with, they do still live at home.
sentences.zh: 我共事过的大多数助理心理学家仍然和父母住在一起。

sentences.en: So it is accessible to go on that band four wage.
sentences.zh: 所以拿着四级工资还能维持生活。

sentences.en: But there is absolutely no progression, like you say.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，完全没有晋升空间。

sentences.en: The band five AP roles are non-existent, certainly within the trust that I currently work in.
sentences.zh: 五级的助理心理学家职位几乎不存在，至少在我目前工作的信托机构里是这样。

sentences.en: There aren't band four, band five roles anymore.
sentences.zh: 已经没有四级或五级的职位了。

sentences.en: So you're really stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的被困住了。

sentences.en: And unlike the other banding, whereby you move to the next increment after two years, for band four, it's three.
sentences.zh: 而且与其他职级不同，其他职级在两年后会升到下一个薪档，而四级需要三年。

sentences.en: So you really are very, very stuck in that role.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的会被那个职位死死困住。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you for talking to us about that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你跟我们谈论这些。

sentences.en: And I hope it didn't feel kind of too prying.
sentences.zh: 希望这听起来不会太冒昧。

sentences.en: But I know it is a really important conversation.
sentences.zh: 但我知道这是一个非常重要的对话。

sentences.en: And, yeah, like if we really want to advocate for diversity in our workforce, like it matters, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 而且，如果我们真的想倡导员工队伍的多样性，这很重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, we don't want people to be in a position where they're having to go to the bank and saying, can I have a loan to support me to be an assistant psychologist?
sentences.zh: 我们不希望人们陷入那种不得不去银行贷款来支持自己成为助理心理学家的境地。

sentences.en: Because ultimately, I'll be able to pay that back, hopefully, when I'm a qualified psych.
sentences.zh: 因为最终，希望等我成为合格的心理学家后，我能还清贷款。

sentences.en: Like that's not how we want to be getting diversity in our workforce.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我们想要实现员工队伍多样性的方式。

sentences.en: So tell us then about what came next, you know, so from that one AP role, have you then applied to the doctorate in clinical psychology?
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我们接下来发生了什么，你知道，从那个助理心理学职位开始，你申请了临床心理学博士学位吗？

sentences.en: I knew that before I could apply, I needed 12 months experience, clinical experience, which prior to entering the NHS, I didn't have.
sentences.zh: 我知道在申请之前，我需要12个月的临床经验，而在进入NHS之前，我没有这些经验。

sentences.en: So initially, I thought, great, I will graduate and I will apply that year and that will start the process.
sentences.zh: 所以起初我想，太好了，我毕业后就申请，那一年就开始这个过程。

sentences.en: And then somebody told me the reality and I was very much, oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 然后有人告诉了我现实情况，我当时就觉得，哦，好吧。

sentences.en: So then I had to accept I was going to be an AP on a band for wage for a minimum of two years.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不接受我将要在四级工资水平上至少做两年的助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And I got my head around that through thinking that it would be an investment.
sentences.zh: 我通过把它看作一种投资来调整心态。

sentences.en: I was investing.
sentences.zh: 我是在投资。

sentences.en: This was a stepping stone and it would require some investing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个垫脚石，需要一些投入。

sentences.en: So I worked within the mental health support team as an AP.
sentences.zh: 所以我作为助理心理学家在心理健康支持团队工作。

sentences.en: I worked beyond my remit.
sentences.zh: 我超出了我的职责范围。

sentences.en: I went a little bit further.
sentences.zh: 我多做了一些工作。

sentences.en: I brought over my passion for reducing male suicide based on the experiences I'd had with attempted and completed male suicides into this service.
sentences.zh: 我将自己对减少男性自杀的满腔热情带到了这项服务中，这是基于我过去接触过的男性自杀未遂和已遂案例的经历。

sentences.en: It was clear from the outset there was a huge disparity between the number of boys and girls being referred into the service for low mood and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就很明显，被转介到该服务中心进行低落情绪和焦虑治疗的男孩和女孩人数之间存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: And I really wanted to understand why that was with male suicide, the leading cause of death in men under the age of 50.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想了解原因，因为男性自杀是50岁以下男性死亡的首要原因。

sentences.en: For me, it was blatantly obvious that we needed to be targeting boys at a younger age to break down those barriers and stigmas,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，显而易见的是，我们需要在更年轻的时候就针对男孩进行干预，打破那些障碍和污名，

sentences.en: enable them to feel safe and secure to access mental health support at a much earlier stage and to recognise the signs of poor mental health,
sentences.zh: 让他们感到安全和有保障，从而在更早的阶段获得心理健康支持，并识别心理健康状况不佳的迹象，

sentences.en: which I think is something that still needs a lot of work.
sentences.zh: 我认为这方面仍然需要做很多工作。

sentences.en: So I started a quality improvement project and I based it in a school and that project really did give me a springboard into my career.
sentences.zh: 所以我发起了一个质量改进项目，并把它放在一所学校里实施，那个项目确实为我的职业生涯提供了一个跳板。

sentences.en: I had a very unique opportunity to present the findings of my project to the Trust Executive Board of Directors.
sentences.zh: 我有一个非常独特的展示机会，向信托执行董事会展示了我的项目成果。

sentences.en: I was able to increase the number of referrals from this school from 4% for boys up to 50% by between January of 2024 and November of 2024.
sentences.zh: 在2024年1月到2024年11月之间，我成功地将该校男孩的转介率从4%提高到了50%。

sentences.en: So in that short space of time, I did that through a number of routes, including boy-only assemblies to raise awareness of mental health,
sentences.zh: 所以在那么短的时间内，我通过多种途径做到了这一点，包括举办仅限男孩参加的集会来提高心理健康意识，

sentences.en: in which I invited a guest speaker from Health Watch Essex who had lived experience of mental health.
sentences.zh: 我还邀请了来自Health Watch Essex的嘉宾演讲者，他有心理健康方面的亲身经历。

sentences.en: I developed a boys participation group to have so that the boys could be heard and they could shape the service they receive.
sentences.zh: 我建立了一个男孩参与小组，让男孩们的声音能被听到，让他们能够塑造他们所接受的服务。

sentences.en: And that gave me an awful lot of really valuable experience that I could use as evidence for my doctorate application, which was really helpful.
sentences.zh: 这给了我大量非常宝贵的经验，我可以将其作为博士申请的证据，这非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And then that's something I really advocate any APs go beyond your role and your remit.
sentences.zh: 这也是我真心建议任何助理心理学家去做的事情：超越你的角色和职责范围。

sentences.en: Look to do something different, such as a quality improvement project.
sentences.zh: 尝试做一些不同的事情，比如质量改进项目。

sentences.en: We know that we go and we do clinical service audits and we'll look at data, but see what more you can do.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们会去做临床服务审计并查看数据，但要看看你还能做些什么。

sentences.en: Because I truly believe that that work that I did, which is work that I would like to continue as part of my thesis,
sentences.zh: 因为我真心相信我所做的那些工作——这也是我希望在论文中继续进行的工作，

sentences.en: if that is I'm allowed to do so, that work really did provide me with that additional evidence that I needed to demonstrate that I was ready for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 如果允许的话——那些工作确实为我提供了额外的证据，证明我已经为攻读博士做好了准备。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it sounds like such an important piece of work and well done to you for kind of reducing that disparity in kind of gender referrals
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来这是一项非常重要的工作，做得好，你成功缩小了性别转介方面的差异，

sentences.en: to actually make it equitable, 50-50, boys and girls.
sentences.zh: 真正做到了公平，男孩和女孩各占50%。

sentences.en: Like that's, you know, really important.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of just going to point out that the episode before this one with Jack Lowe for our watchers and our listeners
sentences.zh: 我还要指出，对于我们的观众和听众来说，上一期与Jack Lowe的节目

sentences.en: is kind of about kind of making the most of the experiences you find yourself in.
sentences.zh: 讲的就是如何充分利用你所处的经历。

sentences.en: And we talk about something called kind of job crafting, which is exactly what you've just spoken about,
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了一种叫做“工作重塑”的概念，这正是你刚才所说的，

sentences.en: kind of trying to really maximise your opportunities for learning and growth.
sentences.zh: 试图真正最大化你的学习和成长机会。

sentences.en: So if people want to learn more about that and haven't already watched or listened to the episode with Jack, please do check that episode out as well.
sentences.zh: 所以如果人们想了解更多相关信息，且还没有观看或收听过Jack的那期节目，请务必去看看。

sentences.en: So you got all this kind of on a form, you know, you were happy with your form, you clicked submit, then what happened?
sentences.zh: 所以你把所有这些都填在表格里了，你对表格很满意，点击了提交，然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Then I changed jobs.
sentences.zh: 然后我换了工作。

sentences.en: So I stayed within the mental health support team beyond the 12 months purely because I wanted to see through the quality improvement project.
sentences.zh: 我留在心理健康支持团队超过了12个月，纯粹是因为我想把那个质量改进项目做完。

sentences.en: So I stayed in the end, I think it was 19 months, so longer, longer than anticipated.
sentences.zh: 所以最后我待了19个月，比预期的要长。

sentences.en: However, I clicked submit and thought, OK, I'm either going to get on this year or I'm not.
sentences.zh: 不过，我点击提交后心想，好吧，今年要么录取，要么不录取。

sentences.en: The likelihood is I'm not.
sentences.zh: 很可能不会录取。

sentences.en: The odds are stacked against me because we know the statistics, we know the ratio, we know the chances of getting on first time are really, really slim.
sentences.zh: 胜算对我来说很小，因为我们知道统计数据，知道比例，知道第一次申请就成功的几率非常非常小。

sentences.en: So I need another role.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要另一个职位。

sentences.en: If I'm going to apply a second time, I need a different position in a different service to show that I am expanding my skills
sentences.zh: 如果我要申请第二次，我需要在不同的服务部门担任不同的职位，以展示我正在扩展我的技能，

sentences.en: and I'm able to diversify and work within another setting.
sentences.zh: 并且我有能力实现多元化，在另一个环境中工作。

sentences.en: So I applied for a number of assistant psychologist roles within Essex, where I live, and within London as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我申请了埃塞克斯（我居住的地方）以及伦敦的一些助理心理学家职位。

sentences.en: I was really lucky, once again, I had an interview with an eating disorder service based in Barking,
sentences.zh: 我再次非常幸运，获得了一份位于Barking的饮食失调服务机构的面试机会，

sentences.en: covering Barking and Dagenham, Waltham Forest, Redbridge and Havering, boroughs of London.
sentences.zh: 覆盖了伦敦的Barking and Dagenham、Waltham Forest、Redbridge和Havering等行政区。

sentences.en: And in April of this year, I joined the intensive support pathway of the CAMHS section of the eating disorders service.
sentences.zh: 今年4月，我加入了饮食失调服务机构CAMHS部门的强化支持路径。

sentences.en: So I've been working as an AP now since April.
sentences.zh: 所以我从4月开始一直担任助理心理学家。

sentences.en: I did break the news prior to starting.
sentences.zh: 我在开始工作前就透露了这个消息。

sentences.en: Great news for me, but I said, you know, for full transparency, they knew that I had applied.
sentences.zh: 对我来说是好消息，但我说，为了完全透明，他们知道我申请了博士。

sentences.en: I was very open in the interview I had applied.
sentences.zh: 我在面试时非常坦诚地说我申请了。

sentences.en: I said, for full transparency, I have been offered a place and I have accepted.
sentences.zh: 我说，为了完全透明，我已经获得了录取名额，并且我已经接受了。

sentences.en: So my time here will be short, but I, you know, I will give it everything 100%.
sentences.zh: 所以我在那里的时间会很短，但我会百分之百投入。

sentences.en: And they wanted some support with setting up a quality improvement project, which is ongoing at the moment.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正需要一些支持来建立一个质量改进项目，目前正在进行中。

sentences.en: So they were still keen for me to go, which I was really relieved about, because actually I was really excited at getting that experience.
sentences.zh: 所以他们仍然很乐意录用我，我对此感到非常欣慰，因为我真的很兴奋能获得那种经验。

sentences.en: So from April until I start on the 1st of October, I'm in the eating disorder service.
sentences.zh: 所以从4月到10月1日我开始博士学习期间，我都在饮食失调服务机构工作。

sentences.en: And the experience is incomparable to anything that I've ever done before.
sentences.zh: 那种经验是我以前从未有过的，无法比拟。

sentences.en: Having that physical health component, the assistant psychologist role is so valuable.
sentences.zh: 拥有那种身体健康方面的组成部分，助理心理学家的角色非常有价值。

sentences.en: I feel like a nurse, I do blood pressure, I do the way in the bloods, temperature, and I really enjoy that physical health aspect.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己像个护士，我测量血压、体重、血液、体温，我真的很享受那种身体健康方面的实践。

sentences.en: I work really closely with psychiatrists, clinical psychologists, psychotherapists, really, really experienced clinical nurse specialists.
sentences.zh: 我与精神科医生、临床心理学家、心理治疗师以及非常有经验的临床专科护士密切合作。

sentences.en: And I feel so fortunate to have been able to have these five months within that service.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常幸运，能在那个服务部门度过这五个月。

sentences.en: So that is what I did.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的事情。

sentences.en: So after I click submit, that's what I initially did.
sentences.zh: 所以在我点击提交后，我最初就是这么做的。

sentences.en: And that's worked out well.
sentences.zh: 而且结果很好。

sentences.en: It has.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But I do want to shift your narrative perspective slightly, because you keep telling us that you're lucky.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想稍微改变一下你的叙述视角，因为你一直告诉我们你很幸运。

sentences.en: You're very skilled.
sentences.zh: 你非常有能力。

sentences.en: You're a strong applicant and you deserve to be here.
sentences.zh: 你是一位强有力的申请者，你理应来到这里。

sentences.en: You have had a successful long career as a police sergeant and all that that entails with working with offenders,
sentences.zh: 你作为警长有着长期成功的职业生涯，这其中包含了与罪犯打交道、

sentences.en: working probably closely with families as well and staff teams, you know, and kind of the police organisation as a whole.
sentences.zh: 与家庭以及员工团队密切合作，你知道，还有整个警察组织的工作。

sentences.en: Also, you've applied yourself very, very firmly and strongly in your OU degree.
sentences.zh: 此外，你在开放大学的学位学习中也非常坚定和努力。

sentences.en: And you've got a first and you've gone above and beyond in every role you've done and done that job crafting.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了第一名，并且在你所做的每一个角色中都超越了自我，完成了那种工作重塑。

sentences.en: But also, you know, you haven't thought, right, well, I've clicked submit.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你知道，你还没想过，对吧，好吧，我已经点击提交了。

sentences.en: I'll just wait and see.
sentences.zh: 我只能等着看结果。

sentences.en: You've thought, well, how can I make myself an even stronger applicant?
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，好吧，我怎样才能让自己成为一个更强的申请者呢？

sentences.en: So I've got maybe something else extra to talk about at interview or, you know, or just more strings to my bow for next time.
sentences.zh: 这样我面试时可能就有额外的东西可以谈，或者，你知道，为下次多准备一些筹码。

sentences.en: You deserve to be here, Claire, and I'm so excited for your future cohort who who gets a police sergeant, you know, background and expertise,
sentences.zh: 克莱尔，你理应来到这里，我为你未来的同学感到非常兴奋，他们将迎来一位有警察中士背景和专业知识的同学，你知道，

sentences.en: who gets, you know, someone that's a mummy to two probably quite grown up people now.
sentences.zh: 他们将迎来一位已经是两个可能已经长大成人的孩子的妈妈。

sentences.en: So you've come through the education system, who is married and all that that entails, who likely has her own experience of grief, loss, friendships,
sentences.zh: 你经历了教育体系，你已婚，经历了婚姻带来的一切，你可能也有过自己的悲伤、失落、友谊的经历，

sentences.en: but also applying yourself and holding yourself accountable and self-actualising.
sentences.zh: 但你也一直在努力，对自己负责，并实现自我价值。

sentences.en: I would say you are not lucky.
sentences.zh: 我想说，你并不是靠运气。

sentences.en: You are an incredibly strong candidate and that the doctorate course are lucky to have you.
sentences.zh: 你是一位极其强大的候选人，博士课程能拥有你是他们的幸运。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I think we experience imposter syndrome quite a lot, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我想我们经常会经历冒名顶替综合症，不是吗？

sentences.en: I remember getting the first AP role and being told it can take years to get your first AP role.
sentences.zh: 我记得我得到第一份助理心理学家（AP）职位时，有人告诉我，拿到第一份AP职位可能需要几年时间。

sentences.en: I had a 10 year plan.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一个十年计划。

sentences.en: My 10 year plan was I started my degree at the age of 40 in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我的十年计划是，我在2018年40岁时开始攻读学位。

sentences.en: And my 10 year plan worked like this.
sentences.zh: 我的十年计划是这样的。

sentences.en: OK, so six years for the degree that was initially, one year clinical experience, three years doctorate and I will qualify at 50.
sentences.zh: 好的，学位需要六年，最初是这样，一年临床经验，三年博士课程，我将在50岁时获得资格。

sentences.en: I then brought that down to five years and then I had that realisation that actually it would be two years before I could start the doctorate once I started to get clinical.
sentences.zh: 后来我把它缩短到了五年，然后我意识到，实际上在我开始临床工作后，还需要两年时间才能开始博士课程。

sentences.en: But I'd have to get on first time.
sentences.zh: 但我必须一次就成功。

sentences.en: So this 10 year plan was going to be tough.
sentences.zh: 所以这个十年计划将会非常艰巨。

sentences.en: I got the first, I secured my AP role literally within a few weeks of getting my final result for the degree.
sentences.zh: 我在拿到学位最终成绩后的几周内就获得了我的第一份AP职位。

sentences.en: And I remember on my first day going into my trust and I worked for a wonderful trust, Nelft, North East London Foundation TruSt.
sentences.zh: 我记得第一天去我的信托机构报到时，我为一家很棒的信托机构工作，Nelft，东北伦敦基金会信托。

sentences.en: I'm picking up my badge and seeing the words assistant psychologist on my ID badge and feeling so proud, so chuffed going in.
sentences.zh: 我领到胸牌，看到ID卡上写着“助理心理学家”几个字，感到非常自豪，非常高兴。

sentences.en: And on my first day, I met with my team and I worked with some wonderful people in mental health support team.
sentences.zh: 第一天，我见到了我的团队，我和心理健康支持团队里一些很棒的人一起工作。

sentences.en: But there was this one individual who was band five at the time.
sentences.zh: 但当时有一个人，她是五级职员。

sentences.en: So not a senior.
sentences.zh: 所以不是高级职员。

sentences.en: And she said to me in front of everybody, I don't mean to be rude, but you're only a band four.
sentences.zh: 她在所有人面前对我说，我不是想冒犯，但你只是个四级职员。

sentences.en: What could you actually do?
sentences.zh: 你到底能做什么？

sentences.en: And at that point, my bubble burst and that realisation hit me.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我的泡沫破灭了，现实击中了我。

sentences.en: I'm only a band four.
sentences.zh: 我只是个四级职员。

sentences.en: And I've been fighting against that psychologically ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我一直在心理上与这种想法作斗争。

sentences.en: And I think that's why I probably on reflection use terms such as lucky.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么回顾过去，我可能会用“幸运”这样的词。

sentences.en: I've been called out a few times for saying I'm only a band four.
sentences.zh: 我因为说自己“只是个四级职员”而被纠正过几次。

sentences.en: And my colleagues and my seniors have said, Claire, you're not.
sentences.zh: 我的同事和上级说，克莱尔，你不是。

sentences.en: You're not only a band four.
sentences.zh: 你不仅仅是个四级职员。

sentences.en: You're so much more than a band four.
sentences.zh: 你远不止是个四级职员。

sentences.en: You're so different to any assistant psychologist we've ever had.
sentences.zh: 你和我们见过的任何助理心理学家都完全不同。

sentences.en: You need to stop saying you're only a band four.
sentences.zh: 你需要停止说自己只是个四级职员。

sentences.en: And I would second that.
sentences.zh: 我对此表示赞同。

sentences.en: But also, you know, a question that I'll often ask someone in a trauma service is how much of that that that person said to you, do you need to hold on to?
sentences.zh: 但同时，你知道，我经常问创伤服务部门的人一个问题：那个人对你说的那些话，有多少是你需要放在心上的？

sentences.en: And how much can you let go?
sentences.zh: 又有多少是可以放下的呢？

sentences.en: That comment has driven me.
sentences.zh: 那句评论一直激励着我。

sentences.en: And after my bubble burst, it lit a fire in my belly.
sentences.zh: 在我的泡沫破灭后，它点燃了我心中的火焰。

sentences.en: And yes, I am currently a band five.
sentences.zh: 是的，我现在是五级职员。

sentences.en: I'm going to be a band six.
sentences.zh: 我即将成为六级职员。

sentences.en: I'm going to leap.
sentences.zh: 我要跨越这一步。

sentences.en: I'm going to be that band six.
sentences.zh: 我要成为那个六级职员。

sentences.en: I'm then on qualification going to be a band seven.
sentences.zh: 获得资格后，我将成为七级职员。

sentences.en: Within 12 months, I'll be an eight A.
sentences.zh: 12个月内，我将成为8A级。

sentences.en: And my aim is a band nine.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是九级职员。

sentences.en: I want to be making I want to be an executive director.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名执行董事。

sentences.en: I want to be making fundamental changes and improvements within the NHS, within the trust from a band four.
sentences.zh: 我想从四级职员做起，在NHS内部，在信托机构内部做出根本性的改变和改进。

sentences.en: I have battled to make those changes.
sentences.zh: 我一直在努力争取做出这些改变。

sentences.en: I've it's to me, it's so clear what we need to do, for example, in schools to reduce male suicide.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我们为了减少男性自杀，在学校里需要做什么，是非常清楚的。

sentences.en: Let's start with the younger generation now.
sentences.zh: 让我们现在就从年轻一代开始吧。

sentences.en: But as a band four, I just don't have that network.
sentences.zh: 但作为一个四级职员，我没有那种人脉。

sentences.en: I don't have that connections authority.
sentences.zh: 我没有那种连接权威。

sentences.en: But that comment really drove me.
sentences.zh: 但那句评论确实激励了我。

sentences.en: And that's something that I belong to a number of AP foruMs.
sentences.zh: 这也是我加入许多AP论坛的原因。

sentences.en: And APs often feel very demoralised by how they're regarded.
sentences.zh: AP们经常因为他们受到的待遇而感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: People don't have an understanding of the skills that they bring.
sentences.zh: 人们不了解他们所具备的技能。

sentences.en: And I use that story a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常讲那个故事。

sentences.en: Let that bring fire in your belly.
sentences.zh: 让它点燃你心中的火焰吧。

sentences.en: One day, I will supervise that clinician and I will remind her what she told me.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，我会督导那位临床医生，我会提醒她她曾经对我说了什么。

sentences.en: And I will ask her never, never to repeat that and never say that to anybody else that is on their way up.
sentences.zh: 我会要求她永远、永远不要再重复那句话，也永远不要对任何正在进步的人说那样的话。

sentences.en: You are a force to be reckoned with.
sentences.zh: 你是一股不可忽视的力量。

sentences.en: And I am excited to see how you thrive and how you grow.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋看到你如何茁壮成长。

sentences.en: And please do keep us posted.
sentences.zh: 请务必随时向我们通报你的近况。

sentences.en: If you've got any kind of last advice for someone listening to this, who's maybe not feeling that maybe their time has ticked past for them or that they, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果你对正在听这段节目的某个人有什么最后的建议，也许他们觉得自己的时间已经不多了，或者他们，你知道，

sentences.en: they've been burned by people that have made them feel that they can't do this.
sentences.zh: 被那些让他们觉得自己做不到的人伤害过。

sentences.en: What would you say, Claire?
sentences.zh: 你会说什么，克莱尔？

sentences.en: This is a long, hard process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个漫长而艰难的过程。

sentences.en: Like to become a clinical psychologist, I think is actually longer than to become a medical doctor.
sentences.zh: 我觉得成为一名临床心理学家的过程实际上比成为一名医生还要长。

sentences.en: I think it takes longer.
sentences.zh: 我认为这需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: It has to be your passion, your dream.
sentences.zh: 这必须是你的热情，你的梦想。

sentences.en: You have to be motivated.
sentences.zh: 你必须有动力。

sentences.en: You have to really, really, really want it.
sentences.zh: 你必须真的、真的、非常想要它。

sentences.en: If you don't, I don't think it's necessarily the right path for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想要，我不认为这一定是你正确的道路。

sentences.en: But if you do, then never give up.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想要，那就永远不要放弃。

sentences.en: I have a friend who I've met through AP foruMs.
sentences.zh: 我有一个通过AP论坛认识的朋友。

sentences.en: We worked on AP community of practice together with the psychology professions, psychological professions network, the PPN.
sentences.zh: 我们一起在心理学专业网络（PPN）的AP实践社区工作。

sentences.en: And she got on this year after seven attempts.
sentences.zh: 她在尝试七次后，今年成功入选了。

sentences.en: She's also an older applicant.
sentences.zh: 她也是一位年龄较大的申请者。

sentences.en: She has children.
sentences.zh: 她有孩子。

sentences.en: And this was her seventh year.
sentences.zh: 这是她的第七年。

sentences.en: And she's got on.
sentences.zh: 她成功了。

sentences.en: So if that's what you really want, then just, just don't give up.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这是你真正想要的，那就，就不要放弃。

sentences.en: Be really, really focused.
sentences.zh: 要非常、非常专注。

sentences.en: And look beyond the undergrad.
sentences.zh: 眼光要超越本科阶段。

sentences.en: Look beyond the band for and the future.
sentences.zh: 眼光要超越四级职员和未来。

sentences.en: And that's what I've always held in mind.
sentences.zh: 这就是我一直铭记在心的。

sentences.en: So when I'm feeling really demoralized, really undervalued, I hold that in mind.
sentences.zh: 所以当我感到非常沮丧、非常不被重视时，我会记住这一点。

sentences.en: I hold that.
sentences.zh: 我坚持这一点。

sentences.en: And when I got that email to say, been offered a place, I cannot begin to describe how that felt.
sentences.zh: 当我收到那封录取通知邮件时，我无法用言语形容那种感觉。

sentences.en: It was unreal that I got that.
sentences.zh: 我被录取了，这太不真实了。

sentences.en: I got one shot.
sentences.zh: 我只有一次机会。

sentences.en: I got one interview, one shot.
sentences.zh: 我只有一次面试，一次机会。

sentences.en: And I knew everything was, was waging on that.
sentences.zh: 我知道一切都押在那上面了。

sentences.en: The other three, I didn't get an interview.
sentences.zh: 另外三个，我没有得到面试机会。

sentences.en: I wasn't shortlisted.
sentences.zh: 我没有进入候选名单。

sentences.en: So I had one shot.
sentences.zh: 所以我只有一次机会。

sentences.en: I was my true authentic self in interview.
sentences.zh: 我在面试中展现了真实、本色的自我。

sentences.en: Everybody told me to be.
sentences.zh: 每个人都告诉我应该这样做。

sentences.en: I thought, I don't think that's good enough.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不认为这足够好。

sentences.en: On the day I decided I would be, and it's paid off.
sentences.zh: 但在那一天，我决定我会这样做，而且这得到了回报。

sentences.en: Just don't, don't give up.
sentences.zh: 千万不要，不要放弃。

sentences.en: And it's never, ever, ever too late to change career.
sentences.zh: 改变职业永远、永远、永远都不晚。

sentences.en: I will qualify at 50.
sentences.zh: 我将在50岁时获得资格。

sentences.en: I have no plans to retire.
sentences.zh: 我没有退休的计划。

sentences.en: I've got friends my age that's talking about winding down.
sentences.zh: 我有和我同龄的朋友在谈论退休养老。

sentences.en: I'm winding up.
sentences.zh: 我正在蓄势待发。

sentences.en: And I will continue working for as long as my brain will allow me to cognitively continue working.
sentences.zh: 只要我的大脑允许我认知上继续工作，我就会继续工作。
